newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays weak, ranges tight with NY.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays weak, ranges tight with NY.

text.p: Light commission house selling countered trade buying of London's nearby white sugar futures on Tuesday afternoon, keeping the market pinioned in tight trading ranges.
Traders said the spot May whites contract was unlikely to show any dramatic moves as long as the New York market was also content to meander in a tight range.
"There's not a very big range on the raws so we can't really expect too much on the whites," said one.
"It's been pretty quiet and the numbers aren't big at all, by anybody's standards."
At 1705 GMT May was down $1 at $306 after moving in a range of just 70 cents. It dominated the light overall turnover of 506 lots. August was down 70 cents at $305.
Traders noted limited interest in arbitrage dealings against the New York market with August/July selling at around $70.50 and $71.00.
Libya was reported to be open to buy at least one cargo of white sugar but possibly more if prices were attractive. The shipment period was thought to be May.
The Paris market was also reluctant to move very far and Matif volume amounted to a scant 311 lots. May was unchanged at $306.50 and August down 60 cents at $304.90.
